reason: Phagocytes are shown clearing debris at the cut, a plausible early part of wound repair.
expectation: The wound will be cleared of some debris while the vessel remains sealed.

alternatives.reason: The signals also visibly point toward the nearby vessel, suggesting a route to improving the wound's blood supply.

effect: Phagocytes cleared debris, revealing supply, surface and support slots for the healing wound.
reaction: The three slots make the remaining repair jobs clearer.
reason: The repair signals point to the nearby vessel, suggesting they can help establish wound supply.
expectation: The vessel will respond to the signals and help supply the wound.

effect: Repair signals produced a capillary sprout connected to the existing circulation, suggesting a supply for the wound.
reaction: The new branch makes the supply connection clear.
reason: The capillary sprout appears to fit the healing body's supply slot.
expectation: The sprout will supply the healing wound.

effect: The sprout filled the supply slot and formed a connected blood-flow route to the wound.
reaction: The completed vessel loop clarifies how nutrients reach the repair site.
reason: The fibroblast picture shows a collagen gene, and the RNA building blocks are shown entering its nucleus.
expectation: The fibroblasts will make an RNA message for collagen production.

effect: The fibroblasts now have a collagen RNA message ready for ribosomes.
reaction: The image clearly distinguishes the DNA from its RNA copy.
reason: Matrix nutrients include amino acids, which the fibroblasts need to make collagen from the RNA instructions.
expectation: The fibroblasts will produce collagen to support the wound.

effect: The fibroblasts used the RNA instructions and nutrients to produce extracellular collagen-rich connective tissue.
reaction: The sequence connects gene expression to physical wound support clearly.
reason: The new connective tissue should fit the wound's support slot.
expectation: The connective tissue will support the healing wound.

effect: The new connective tissue filled the support slot; the surface still needs closing.
reaction: The note that young tissue remains weaker adds useful context.
reason: Epidermal edge cells and their nutrients appear to be the pieces needed to rebuild the surface.
expectation: The edge cells will grow or spread to form a replacement surface.

effect: The edge cells formed a new epidermal surface, ready to close the remaining surface slot.
reaction: The sheet extending across the gap makes the closure easy to follow.
reason: The new surface matches the healing body's remaining surface slot.
expectation: The new epidermal sheet will close the wound surface.

effect: The new surface completed the wound closure, support and supply goal; the temporary clot still needs clearing.
reaction: The distinction between a closed surface and deeper tissue still strengthening is useful.
reason: Clot-clearing enzymes are shown breaking down fibrin, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the temporary fibrin clot in the healing wound.

effect: Clot-clearing enzymes removed much of the temporary fibrin, completing the repair goals while leaving a still-maturing scar.
reaction: The distinction between clearing the clot and continued collagen remodeling is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen support was most worthwhile: the planned images connect a DNA-to-RNA message and protein production to extracellular tissue that supports the wound.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface into its clearly named slot was straightforward but less informative than making it; the result largely repeated that cells crossed the gap.

surprise.text: The capillary sprout joined another nearby vessel to form a flow route, making the link between a new branch and wound nourishment more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the named slots and picture descriptions made the repair pieces' purposes clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter offered similarly concrete connections between cellular processes and body function, though the slot-fitting itself became predictable.
